Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1247
Claimant:
Brittany Jackson
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
August 4, 2023
First notice of loss came in from the claimant, who reported a side impact at an intersection and said the other vehicle
entered on a red light. The claimant was not represented by counsel and confirmed they were the driver named on
the policy.
August 17, 2023
Reviewed the police report, which confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision. Scene photos
supplied by the claimant show damage to the drvier side door and rear quarter panel, though no independent
witnesses have come forward.
October 4, 2023
Spoke with the claimant about the injury, which was reported as a concussion. The symptoms described are plausible
for a collision of this type, and the claimant has no known prior injury to the head or neck area.
October 14, 2023
Reviewed the vehicle's service records and prior claim history, and nothing suggests the damage predates the start
of coverage. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on file.
October 17, 2023
Treatment followed a typical course, with follow-up visits tapering as the claimant's symptoms improved. Still unclear
from the repair estimate and photos whether all of the listed damage stems from this impact, so a secondary
inspection has been requested.
February 9, 2024
The claimant has given the same account of the collision in every conversation so far, with no changes to the
sequence of events. File remains open pending the inspection results and final medical documentation.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
